newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Country Road sees entry to South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Country Road sees entry to South Africa.

text.p: Clothing retailer Country Road Ltd said on Thursday it was confident that plans to market its brand in South Africa with South African retailer Wooltru Ltd would be finalised in coming months.
Country Road earlier said Wooltru, which owns retailers Woolworths and Truworths, had acquired a 14.86 percent stake in the company.
Country Road chief executive Mike Howell said his company was exploring the possibility of marketing its brand in South Africa with Woolworths.
Howell said he was confident the arrangements would be finalised over the next few months.

"This would give us yet another link in our international strategy of marketing our brand with experienced local operators as we are already doing with the Inchcape Group and Itochu," he said in a statement.
Country Road chairman Bill Loewenthal said the company welcomed Woolworths as a major shareholder.
Country Road has two stores in Japan and said recently it expected to open 25-30 outlets during the next five years in conjuction with Itochu Corp, which also owns 25 percent of its U.S. opeations.
Elsewhere in Asia, Country Road is planning new store sites in Singapore, Hong Kong and Indonesia in partnership with Inchcape.
